newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Eastern plans A-share issue.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern plans A-share issue.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it proposed to issue and list China domestic ordinary shares (A-shares) for mainland Chinese investors.
The issue size would be no more than 500 million shares and account for no more than 11 percent of the company's total share capital, the airline said in its results statement.
China Eastern gave no further details on the issue but said the proposal was subject to the approval of Chinese authorities.
The Shanghai-based airlines operator, which is 65.7 percent owned by China's EA Group, was listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange in February after an H-share offering.
